findings.language_policy: Best-effort Chinese and English with an independent pause/VAD segmenter and a fresh automatic language decision per speech segment.
findings.throughput: Both models remain far ahead of real time on the measured Apple M4 Pro host and accumulate no recognition backlog.
findings.model_accuracy: Both models score zero WER on the English fixture. large-v3-turbo makes one Mandarin lexical error; small makes more lexical errors and emits Traditional Chinese. The raw Han CER overstates that gap because it intentionally counts Traditional/Simplified differences.
findings.mixed_language_blocker: With one automatic language decision for a 30-second window, neither model retains both languages: small emits only Chinese and large-v3-turbo emits only English.
remaining_release_qualification: benchmark older Apple Silicon before widening support beyond the measured M4 Pro host
